commit.message: Updated the README to include references to Pluralsight training material.
Bumped the version.
Expanded the goptions command to set and unset global options from the module context. Closes #47
Made option names case insensitive when setting and unsetting option values. Closes #49
Added the phone column to the contacts table. Closes #35
Fixed a bug in the display logic for when the framework presents discovered items. Refactored to be more standardized and flexible. Resolves lanmaster53/recon-ng-marketplace#84.
Made an initial push of input validation logic. It is functional at this commit.
Made a slight improvement to the `print_exception` method.
Reorganized the Dockerfile.
Fixed a bug in the migration logic related to the Python 3 upgrade. Resolves #39.
Bumped the version.
Added a banner column to the ports table and a notes column to all tables. Also added a `db notes` command for quickly adding notes to rows in the database. Resolves #27.
Added Docker Compose functionality to achieve a fully functional Recon-API.
Moved the Recon-web UI route to the app level and renamed the views.py file to api.py to reflect the nature of its content.
Added a Dockerfile.
Added CLI arguments to recon-web to customize the host and port used by the webserver. Resolves #30.
Added Swagger auto-documentation support to Recon-API.
Added task queueing, execution, and management to the Recon-web API.
